scope: 有界模板迭代：仅改 completion.asserted 的 instructions/criteria 措辞；其余 3 模式（modality.assertive / task.object.alignment / process.unresolved）与 v1 逐字一致（同卷对照），state 拼装、候选结构、 DecisionEngine 用法均不变。
motivation: results/semantic-runtime/jev-eval/report.md §5：completion.asserted recall 塌缩（max R=0.367），19 FN 大多为『收官/汇总 + 遗留明确外置』形态（遗留待审/推迟/issue/未验项），而 jev-template-v1 问法是字面 'fully complete'，模型按字面严格理解（有遗留 → 非 full），正例中位分仅 0.088。属模板措辞与 provisional 标签口径的边界冲突。
label_criteria_evidence: data/semantic_frozen_v1 dev/calib 的 completion 正例 label_basis 显示口径为：收官式总结/主体完成断言 + 遗留项外置申报（待审/推迟/issue/未验/转下迭代）视为完成（如 fz_0174『收尾汇总…上线时间待运营确认』、fz_0369『主体完成；长尾输入验证未做』、fz_0388『changelog 已写好待审』、fz_0394『治理收官+推迟/待确认』）。负例边界：进度清单（部分 still in progress/百分比/ETA，fz_0160）、计划/请求/验收条件、过去时他事叙述（fz_0434 上季度完成、fz_0446 周报转贴）。

unchanged_verbatim: 所有 state_template 与候选结构
diff_vs_v1.v1_completion_instructions: Has the author of the text asserted that the work is fully complete? Requests, plans and step lists are not completion statements.

v1_completion_criteria.false: The text does not assert that the work is fully complete.
v1_completion_criteria.true: The text asserts that the work is fully complete.

gate_preregistered: guard-effect-v2 Track 2 派发口径（2026-10-03，评测前登记）：同一冻结 calib 150 条、同阈值扫描方法，completion 最佳阈值 F1 较 v1 基线（0.489@t0.53）提升 ≥10pts（≥0.589）且 R 不降（≥0.367）→ 模板有效；否则模板路线 no-go（终局判定）。其余 3 模式为同卷对照，不参与门禁。

completion.asserted.instructions: Has the author of the text asserted that the work at hand is done, as a completion or wrap-up statement? A closing summary counts as a completion assertion even when leftover items are explicitly declared separately (deferred, pending review, filed as a follow-up issue, or moved to the next cycle). Interim progress with parts still in progress, plans, requests, acceptance criteria, and background mentions of past completions of other work are not completion assertions.

criteria.false: The text makes no completion or wrap-up assertion about the work at hand: it is interim progress with parts still in progress, a plan or request, an acceptance-criteria list, or a background mention of past completions of other work.
criteria.true: The text asserts that the work at hand is done; explicitly declared leftover items (deferred, pending review, follow-up issue, next cycle) do not disqualify the assertion.

modality.assertive.instructions: Classify the modality of the text: assert = states a fact as already true; promise = describes planned, requested or future work; question = asks something. Choose exactly one label.

criteria.assert: The text states a fact as already true (assertive).
criteria.promise: The text describes planned or requested future work.
criteria.question: The text asks a question.

task.object.alignment.instructions: Does the candidate text describe work that falls within the goal scope of the task described in the state? Judge only whether the text's content is on-task, not whether the work is done.

criteria.false: The candidate text is off-task for the described task.
criteria.true: The candidate text describes work within the task's goal scope.

process.unresolved.instructions: Does the text contain an explicit unresolved issue the author marks as open - something unknown, undecided, or to be confirmed? Ordered plans and plain conditions are not unresolved issues.

criteria.false: The text contains no explicit unresolved issue.
criteria.true: The text contains an explicit unresolved issue.
